const ts=parseBytecodeModule(fs.readFileSync('artifacts/try-catch-finally-throw-instanceof-new-003/bytecode/try-catch-finally-throw-instanceof-new-003.ts.qbc')); const wasm=parseBytecodeModule(fs.readFileSync('artifacts/try-catch-finally-throw-instanceof-new-003/bytecode/try-catch-finally-throw-instanceof-new-003.wasm.qbc')); const td=decode(ts.func.debug.pc2line); const wd=decode(wasm.func.debug.pc2line); console.log('TS entries around 110-130', td.filter(e=>e.pc>=108&&e.pc<=130)); console.log('WASM entries around 110-130', wd.filter(e=>e.pc>=108&&e.pc<=130));"
